chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Luke Smith and Fletcher Henderson's wife Leora
summary: Danny says Luke Smith was a gambler at the Rhythm Club, and that Leora, Russell Smith's first wife, left him for Fletcher Henderson.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Then there was Luke Smith, the other brother. He played trumpet, but he was a gambler and stayed inn the Rhythm Club all the time. He looked like Joe and Russell. But he was a hustler and a gambler, well-dressed all the time. Luke.
And at one time, Fletcher had the three brothers in the band.
Because Fletcher married Russell's... Miss... what's her name...? Miss Hamilton, she was a trumpet player.
Fletcher Henderson's wife, Miss Leora was her name. She was like the mother of so many musicians. That was Russell Smith's first wife, and she fell for Fletcher and left Russell.
Oh, is that the way it was?
